v) maintains daily records of patients and makes these accessible to the insurance company’s authorized personnel

This waiting period is calculated from the date of inception of the first policy with the insurer. The reimbursement is applicable up to the sum insured and only if the treatment is provided by a registered AYUSH Medical Practitioner at a dedicated AYUSH therapy section or AYUSH Day Care Centre.
reference: Medical expenses for inpatient hospitalization incurred on treatment under Ayurveda, Yoga and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy systems in an AYUSH hospital are payable up to the sum insured.

user_input: When does the automatic restoration of sum insured occur and how can it be used?
response: The sum insured will be restored unlimited number of times, up to 100% each time, upon partial or full utilization for a subsequent hospitalization. Restoration triggers immediately after partial or full utilization of the sum insured. The restored sum insured can be used for all claim purposes, including modern treatments. The unutilized restored sum insured cannot be carried forward to the next policy year.
